verdict.rationale: Drata clearly runs a versioned API: it markets a 'Public APIv2' with expanded endpoints and serves its reference docs under /openapi/reference/v2/ paths. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timeline, or v1-to-v2 migration commitments, so only the versioning half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, changelog or version lifecycle guarantees, migration guidance from v1, and independent corroboration.
